objective: Define the smallest support gate needed to run CMAC_CORE_mac without Verilator --flatten, so larger NVDLA hierarchy work is not blocked by root-only state images.

observed_blocker.symptom: The non-flattened build reaches cubin generation, but the first hybrid run fails with CUDA illegal memory access.
observed_blocker.root_cause_hypothesis: Generated GPU code follows Verilator vlSymsp/Syms references into submodule storage that is not represented in the current serialized root-only state image.
observed_blocker.why_flatten_is_not_enough: The flattened Verilator build is useful for scoped shape classification, but it cannot prove that the hybrid runtime can execute realistic NVDLA hierarchy boundaries.

required_capability: detect whether generated non-flattened GPU IR dereferences Verilator Syms submodule state
either serialize required submodule/Syms storage into the per-state image or reject the target before launch with a structured unsupported-hierarchy error
preserve the existing flattened CMAC_CORE_mac path as the measured fallback
out_of_scope: broad non-flattened hierarchy generalization beyond this seed

implementation_result.remaining_gap: Non-flattened CMAC_CORE_mac still does not execute; it now fails safely before CUDA launch instead of as an illegal memory access.

claim_scope: non-flattened hierarchy support definition for the scoped CMAC_CORE_mac seed only
non_claims: not CPU versus hybrid speedup claim
